name: Walks toward camera
text: She walks forward toward the camera.
desc: Closing the distance. Confrontation, arrival, a decision already taken. The largest displacement one mover can make WHEN THERE IS DISTANCE TO CLOSE - on a wide it crosses the room, and on a close shot it does nothing at all while its number goes up. Stage it wide.
needs: a person in frame with open ground between them and the lens
